_meta.title: Backroom A+B retained cruising candidate QA positions 31–35
_meta.eight_source_limit: Previous batch research cross-referenced 8-source archive and targeted indexed checks; only original directory and selected official operators directly rechecked here. Absence of same-site matches on others is not exhaustive proof.
_meta.interpretation: Statements about activity are attributed to source comments or check-ins, never independently confirmed real-world cruising. Owner controls live website changes.

records.name: Tripla Toilets
records.research_disposition: Retain in research; correct material 24-hour accessibility ambiguity
records.place: Mall of Tripla, Fredikanterassi 1, Pasila; saved 60.198486,24.931262 is general mall/station point, exact toilet and floor not identified by original directory.

last_12_month_evidence.content_summary: Asks if anybody is there; not a report of arrival or encounter.

records.source_detail_access: Specific original page cache miss in public lookup.
records.official_facts: Official Tripla HOURS page: shopping passages minimum 06:00–22:00; general public pedestrian routes 06:00–24:00; only first-floor supermarket shopping passage described as 24/7 because Alepa and Prisma are 24/7. Main mall landing page's simplified 'public areas 24 hours' MUST be read with this detailed page. Restroom hours not confirmed.
records.duplicates: Same combined mall and railway station is not evidence of multiple distinct toilet spots. No cross-source matching same toilet confirmed.
data_quality_findings: Existing description's broad 'mall public passages ... around the clock' is misleading; 24h applies to a specific first-floor zone, not all passages.
Store and passage hours don't verify toilet access.
No recent firsthand encounter is documented.

records.name: Paavonurmi stadion
records.research_disposition: Retain in research as source-listed but unverified activity
records.place: Official place name Paavo Nurmi Stadium, Paavo Nurmen puistotie 9, Turku. Saved 60.4425,22.26083 plausible stadium area; exact alleged restroom/changing room unidentified.

last_12_month_evidence.content_summary: Anonymous contact preference, no observed physical activity.
Asks which WC/toilet was intended at stadium.

records.source_detail_access: Original Gays-Cruising detail inaccessible in public retrieval; older country-index record used with provenance.
records.official_facts: City of Turku confirms stadium gates locked outside opening times, changing rooms are public during season but not open in winter; facility events/bookings control accessibility.
records.duplicates: Source alias/misspelling Paavonurmi stadion maps to official Paavo Nurmi Stadium; do not create a second copy.
data_quality_findings: Current listing correct about winter changing-room closure; current floor/toilet remains unidentified.
No recent firsthand report; do not portray as established active cruising spot.
Gate restrictions must not be confused with stadium's physical existence.

records.name: Ponte fiume Reno a Borgo Panigale
records.research_disposition: Retain in research with confirmed place identity; fix unresolved-bridge label
records.place: Original Italian spot description identified a park beneath the Reno river bridge at Via Emilia Ponente / Via del Triumvirato (Pontelungo). Original driving map pin is 44.5111045837,11.2912950516, as documented in completed 18-location audit.

last_12_month_evidence.content_summary: Asks whether anybody will be there at night; not witnessed activity.

records.source_detail_access: Earlier specialist-language source detail was accessible to the 18-location audit, and map/directions recorded; English URL cache miss in this check.
records.official_facts: Municipality reports Pontelungo refurbishment/transport works completed March 2026, and Via Emilia full two-way access restored February 28. This establishes bridge identity and roadway reopening, not the current state of under-bridge sexual activity or pedestrian path.
records.duplicates: Different from central Montagnola park; no merge.
data_quality_findings: MATERIAL: published research record wrongly states unidentified bridge and Pontelungo merely hypothetical. This was already resolved in 18-location audit.
Address can be accurately revised in future owner-approved data to park under Pontelungo by Via Emilia Ponente/Via del Triumvirato; map pin can use exact original destination.
Do not confuse reopening of roadway with confirmation of any 2026 encounter.

records.name: Parco della Montagnola - VIII Agosto
records.research_disposition: Retain as recent source question only; relevant recent firsthand cruising not established
records.place: Parco della Montagnola is identifiable park by Via Irnerio/Piazza VIII Agosto. Saved 44.501265,11.345754 plausible park locator. Its public toilet Via Irnerio 2/3 is a separate civic facility, not necessarily the cruising location described by old park entry.

last_12_month_evidence.content_summary: Bologna directory index asks whether people really cruise in this park; no witnessed event.
Comment claimed drug dealing and danger; before cutoff, cannot treat as a current confirmed hazard.

records.source_detail_access: Original spot webpage publicly read; latest spot-page comments dated August 2025, with separate newer index question in November 2025.
records.official_facts: Municipal public-toilet listing locates a managed public toilet at Via Irnerio 2/3, with seasonal hours and separate entry tariff. That schedule refers to TOILET, not the entire park. Earlier park gate hours should not be copied from toilet hours.
records.duplicates: Park and named civic WC are not automatically same venue, and source doesn't prove exact toilet as original cruising area.
data_quality_findings: Current write-up should explicitly distinguish the park's gates from Via Irnerio 2/3 public toilet operating hours.
2025-11-18 question just clears date threshold, not evidence of recent physical use.
Original older comment was uncorroborated safety warning; avoid implying ongoing hazard.

records.name: Bagni Palazzo Reale
records.research_disposition: Retain as site-specific July2026 platform check-in; no physical activity proven
records.place: Palazzo Reale at Piazza del Duomo 12, Milan. Saved 45.4632,9.1911 general palace point. Milan municipality confirms TWO visitor WCs: ground floor close to Scalone d'Onore, and first-floor WC near hall 143 reserved for current exhibition visitors. Original gay directory source does not specify which.

last_12_month_evidence.content_summary: Source regional index logged check-in; cannot infer presence on site, let alone encounter.

records.source_detail_access: Original specific spot URL not recovered; evidence refers to Italy country-level entry, so no precisely identified restroom from cruising source.
records.official_facts: Palazzo Reale exhibition hours generally Tuesday–Sunday 10:00–19:30, Thursday until 22:30, Monday closed; visitor admission ends an hour before close (30 minutes for free exhibitions). First-floor toilets serve exhibition visitors. Opening of museum does not mean both toilets open to all passersby.
records.duplicates: Two bathrooms inside one museum, no basis to create separate cruising entries without distinct source descriptions.
data_quality_findings: Public description correct about two toilets; more precise distinction: first-floor WC near exhibition room 143 is specifically for exhibition visitors.
Visitor opening hours should be listed only as museum opening times, not cruising hours.
No primary-source anonymous physical encounter, only digital check-in.

material_corrections: Tripla 24-hour public passage claim requires narrowing to first-floor zone only
Reno Pontelungo is definitively identified by original Italian source directions + map pin; outdated unlocated description
Montagnola park vs public toilet hours are different
Palazzo Reale first-floor WC specifically for exhibition visitors
